mainEntity.name: Are barndominiums allowed under local zoning and building codes in the Verde Valley?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, barndominiums must comply with residential building codes, but zoning rules depend on your specific jurisdiction. In municipalities like Cottonwood or Clarkdale, parcels must be zoned to allow single-family residential dwellings, and the structure must meet local residential codes rather than just agricultural outbuilding standards. Before purchasing land or ordering a kit, verify that local zoning ordinances allow metal residential exteriors and check whether design review guidelines or HOA covenants restrict industrial-style metal siding.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, provided the parcel is zoned for residential use and meets residential building codes. You must verify local municipal guidelines regarding metal residential exteriors and setbacks.
